title: Add tail_tokens method to MessageHistory for token budgeting

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
## Scope

Add token-budgeted history filtering to MessageHistory primitive for Plexus console chat.

## Implementation

**Extend MessageHistory primitive** (`tactus/primitives/message_history.py`)
- Add `tail_tokens(max_tokens)` method - returns last N messages that fit within token budget
- Add `_estimate_tokens(messages)` helper - 4 chars/token heuristic
- Already has `tail(n)` for message count - this is token-based equivalent

**Signature**:
```python
def tail_tokens(self, max_tokens: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return last messages that fit within token budget."""
```

## Testing

Unit tests for:
- Empty history returns empty list
- Single message under budget
- Multiple messages fitting exactly
- Messages exceeding budget (returns subset)
- Very large messages
- Multipart content handling

## Usage (in TAC)

```lua
MessageHistory.replace(history)
local filtered = MessageHistory.tail_tokens(8000)
-- Returns last messages fitting in 8000 token budget
```

## Notes

This is deterministic token budgeting only - no LLM calls, no compaction, no summarization.
